status.current_name: Intelligent Business Computer Systems India Private Limited
status.main_product: Industry 4.0 IoT and Roads O&M Solutions
status.scope_reason: The company provides digital twin creation as a service for road infrastructure operations and maintenance using its own platform combined with AI/ML vehicle camera data capture.
status.evidence: IBC Cube's official website outlines its Roads O&M Solutions, which includes providing Digital Twin Creation as a Service by mapping road network elements onto the IBC Cube platform.

claims.claim: The company reports its IBC Cube Roads O&M Solutions have digitised over 40,000 lane kilometres of roads across India utilizing Digital Twin Creation as a Service to map road assets with geographic information system (GIS) and chainage-level detail, according to a corporate milestone announcement.
claims.corrected: The company reports its IBC Cube Roads O&M Solutions have digitised over 30,000 lane kilometres of roads across India utilizing Digital Twin Creation as a Service to map road assets with geographic information system (GIS) and chainage-level detail, according to a corporate milestone announcement.

claims.claim: The company reports providing "Digital Twin Creation as a Service" that maps project, chainage, and asset information using mobile-based physical asset capture and vehicle camera-based capture using AI/ML object detection.
claims.note: The use of mobile-based physical asset capture and vehicle camera-based capture specifically using AI/ML object detection for Digital Twin Creation as a Service is unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The company reports mapping road elements into a unified digital twin environment on its ibccube.ai platform by integrating GIS-based project, chainage, and asset information alongside real-time IoT sensors, smart cameras, and mobile-captured coordinates to manage over 30,000 lane kilometres of roads in India.
claims.note: The integration of real-time IoT sensors, smart cameras, and mobile-captured coordinates into the digital twin environment to manage the lane kilometres is unconfirmed.

claims.claim: The company reports that its Roads O&M Solutions have maintained over 30,000 lane kilometers across India, incorporating features such as virtual International Roughness Index (IRI) monitoring via patrol vehicles and real-time 4G traffic classification, according to the official IBC Cube platform documentation.

The company reports maintaining over 30,000 lane kilometers of road infrastructure with its Roads O&M Solutions platform, utilizing GIS asset mapping and digital twins to resolve defects across roads and highways in India.

The company reports that its Roads O&M Solutions have maintained over 30,000 lane kilometers across roads and highways in India, utilizing a platform that incorporates digital twins, GIS asset mapping, and vehicle-camera defect inspections.

The company reports that its Roads O&M Solutions have maintained over 30,000 lane kilometers across India, utilizing GIS asset mapping, digital twins, and vehicle camera-based AI/ML defect inspections, as stated on the official IBC Cube Website.

The company bid as a prime participant for a road infrastructure monitoring contract and was ranked H-2 in the final evaluation for the National Highways Infra Investment Managers Private Limited (NHAIMS) RAMS project, as detailed in the National Highways Infra Investment Managers Evaluation Document.
claims.note: prime participant, ranked H-2, National Highways Infra Investment Managers Private Limited (NHAIMS) RAMS project

claims.claim: The company has established relationships with prominent clients and public/private entities in the infrastructure and enterprise space, including Larsen & Toubro, Reliance Infrastructure, BSNL, and Western Railway, to deploy its remote operations, transport, and infrastructure management solutions according to its corporate profile on IBC Cube.

The company reports maintaining over 30,000 lane kilometers of roads and highways utilizing its Roads O&M Solutions platform, which incorporates GIS asset mapping and digital twins, according to the official IBC Cube corporate portal.
